caption:
Google just added a deadline to your inbox.

Miss a Google Business Profile message for 24 hours, and Google can auto-disable your Message button.

That channel doesn't slow down. It disappears from your listing.

Most shops check GBP messages once a day, if that, treating it like old email. That habit used to cost a slow reply. Now it can cost the entire channel.

Do this week:
1. Turn on push notifications for GBP messages, not just email alerts.
2. Assign one person to check it daily, including weekends.
3. If texts, calls, and messages live in separate apps, that's the real gap. One missed channel becomes one lost lead source.

The Black Arrow platform threads every text, email, and message into one inbox, so nothing sits long enough to get shut off.
